hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored slopeEntropy reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_slope BIT-FOR-BIT across the embedding dimension; it is INCREASING in the dimension (an unnormalized Shannon over longer slope patterns); and the signal realizes only a fraction of the possible slope patterns.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: slopeEntropy equals NeuroKit2 entropy_slope to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) across the embedding dimension
